More substance: I went to Real Clear Politics, then put every October general election poll into a spreadsheet and finally tallied up the wins per candidate. You can view/download a PDF here: https://infotomb.com/6rggf

Results: At this time, Trump is far from being the most electable Republican. Out of 107 general election polls taken in October, here are the total wins per candidate:

  • Carson: 13
  • Bush: 12 (+1 tie)
  • Fiorina: 10
  • Rubio: 7 (+2 ties)
  • Trump: 2 (+2 ties)
  • Christie: 2
Any number larger than 10 would be considered "surprising" in my book.
